title: Watercolor 29 Calamint Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in the award-winning WaterColor community- Just a few blocks from the beach- Just a short bike ride from WaterColor Crossings- Professionally decorated- 2 screened porches- Fully-equipped gourmet kitchen- Grill area- Free wifi- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAIL: The beauty lies within the details at 29 Calamint Court! This wonderful 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home in the award-winning community of WaterColor, was professionally designed by a team frequently featured in Better Homes & Gardens, Coastal Living, and Southern Living Magazine. The home radiates charming, antique touches throughout. Natural finishes are showcased in nearly every room with reclaimed heart pine flooring from an 1820s schoolhouse lining the first floor, while heart pine wood beams from an old textile mill are on the ceilings. When entering the home, the screened-in front porch opens up to a spacious great room and gourmet chef's kitchen. The kitchen features custom-built heart pine cabinets as well--complimenting the shiplap walls. In the dining area, up to 11 guests can sit together comfortably for a meal. There is a wet bar featuring exposed brick walls and a powder room down the hall to add convenience when entertaining for a dinner party. The first guest room is also on this floor with a queen bed, access to the back porch, and a private bathroom. Upstairs, the other guest rooms remain with an additional sitting area. There are 2 twin-size day beds in the common space and a flat-screen TV. The primary suite features a private access to the second-floor covered balcony. A king bed, flat-screen TV, and elaborate primary bathroom with a soaking tub and marble walk-in shower are all included for the home's highest level of comfort and luxury. The 2 remaining side-by-side guest rooms feature plush-white bedding on queen beds, each with a private bathroom. Enjoy using the 4 adult bikes provided to take you and your group around the scenic neighborhoods of WaterColor! You're just a short bike ride away from the shops at WaterColor Crossings, and the beautiful Gulf waters are just a few blocks away. Living is as easy outside as it is inside the home--with 2 covered porches and swings, a grill area, and access to all of the nature trails and parks within the community! You'll also have access to the amenities at the WaterColor Beach Club, Boathouse, and Camp WaterColor. Book Today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Living Area: Two Twin Beds with 2 Twin TrundlesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
